2026_01_ATL_PIT.headline: Pittsburgh gets a quarterback leverage point with Atlanta turning the opener over to Cooper Rush
2026_01_ATL_PIT.paragraph1: The Falcons ruled Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix Jr. out, putting Cooper Rush in line to start, while Za’Darius Smith is questionable. The Steelers list Joey Porter Jr. as questionable. Atlanta’s offense now has to preserve rhythm around a late quarterback change against a Pittsburgh defense built to punish hesitation. The Steelers can crowd intermediate windows, disguise pressure and force Rush to prove he can win outside the original structure; Atlanta needs quick-game efficiency and manageable downs to prevent Pittsburgh from dictating protection.
2026_01_ATL_PIT.model_rationale: Pittsburgh’s defensive disguise and pressure menu become more valuable against a replacement quarterback, giving the Steelers a clear mechanism to control passing-down decisions.
